_comment: The digest index. The board reads this on load, then fetches each digest it
has not already imported. It exists because a browser cannot list a directory
and neither can raw.githubusercontent.com, so without an index the board has
no way to discover what the routine wrote.
The daily routine appends a date here and commits data/digests/<date>.json
alongside it. Newest first. Keep this file small: it is fetched on every load.
